text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone loves my big races.
And I love my big races, too.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (—Then there's only one path to choose, right?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah...!
Traaiiiner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Wait, it wasn't~! It's Taiki-san~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but...
It was a super, berry-berry hot race, so I am very satisfied, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is warm and excited!
That is why I will definitely win next time!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No.
I was just thinking about how Taiki-san truly seems to enjoy racing with me~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Of course! Akebono's
races are always exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I saw the Sprinters Stakes,
I have been head over heels for you!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I had just debuted back then,
and I was so excited thinking about
what kind of races were waiting for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—And here comes Hishi Akebono!
Hishi Akebono, running with overwhelming power!!”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Your race!
It struck me like a bolt of thunder!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very, very big and powerful!
The heat of the race was swirling all around you, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so, I thought of Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Racing with Akebono lets us deliver
the absolute highest level of excitement to all the fans cheering for us!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—I even felt that this message could only reach everyone
if I were running in a race with Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: If it isn't a race against me, then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, right. You're right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I was just thinking the exact same thing~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Akebono! I am entering the
Mile CS! So, next time—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Got it!
I definitely won't lose next time either~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the waiting room,
as I waited for Hishi Akebono to return—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr!
choice_data_list: Welcome back! That was a great race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even finish my greeting,
I was hoisted up onto her shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Seiyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, I had arrived at the kitchen
I had visited during the Umastagram stream.
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!
What's the matter all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make some chanko nabe now~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you know
my chanko nabe recipe~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've helped make it before, but I don't think
I've ever actually asked for the proper recipe.
choice_data_list: Maybe I've never really heard it properly before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right~. You see, I spent a lot of time
researching and perfecting my chanko nabe when I was a kid~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go do some shopping first, so just wait a little bit, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't quite sure what she was planning,
but I decided to quietly wait for her return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tick tick tick tick... BOOM)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —You see, my chanko nabe is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: To a clear broth made with kelp, light soy sauce, sake, mirin,and a pinch of salt—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bring out the flavor with sweet meatballs
made with miso and sugar~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So once the soup is simmering,
the first thing to do is prepare the meatballs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Hishi Akebono pulled a bowl of ground chicken close and began cooking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Add miso, sugar, garlic, and ginger to the minced chicken, then knead thoroughly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once it turns whitish,
add water and sake little by little and knead it even more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Adding water makes all that tasty meat juice seep out
much easier~. That's a Buono Point♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, add the carrots and potato starch,
and knead it even mooore~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, the soup in the pot in front of Hishi Akebono was beginning to boil and bubble.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, perfect timing~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With practiced motions, Hishi Akebono scooped up spoonfuls of the minced chicken mixture,
dropping them plop by plop into the broth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep, got it~
No more meatballs!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You see, this is the most important part of my chanko nabe, the secret touch I'm super particular about~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She always cooks in such a carefree way that I never knew she was so particular about it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right.
The veggies are all set up, so now we just wait~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle, subtly sweet aroma of broth and condiments
began to spread throughout the room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's coming to a boil. Just a little bit longer, I think~.
choice_data_list: ...Why chanko nabe all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...For a sumo stable, chanko nabe
is practically their treasure, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Every stable has its own chanko nabe recipe,
and the sumo wrestlers truly cherish
the flavor of their own stable's chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grueling the training is,
eating chanko always restores my energy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It makes me feel ready to give it my all again tomorrow~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, you know—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If the flavor of that chanko nabe changed,
I think it'd be pretty disappointing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"You see, for the people who come to watch me,
and for my friends who want to race against me—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to stay as our usual, *that* chanko nabe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I step into the paddock,
everyone cheers, "So huge~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"You love my running that only I can do,
and you always smile after my races."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just want to keep racing for all the people
who have high hopes for me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if it ends up shortening my racing career,
I want to keep running as myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to keep protecting my flavor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Yep, here you go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, Trainer!
It's piping hot and fresh, and oh-so-buono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I take a bite, then another, of the chanko nabe handed to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweet chicken meatballs in a clear, refreshing soup.
Just as always, it delivered the exact taste I had hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for Hishi Akebono, having her career cut short
would surely be heartbreaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Even so, there's something I want to protect.”
I could feel that fierce resolve in her words.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's definitely run the greatest race.
...they continued."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best!
I'm gonna race with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a firm nod to Hishi Akebono's words—
and before I knew it, I was being lifted up in both of her arms.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Per Hishi Akebono's wishes,
the next race will be the Mile Championship."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's the grand stage to determine the autumn Mile King.
